Verified useful progress:
- branch and PR were published before execution finished, so evidence survived the blocked verdict;
- PR is open/mergeable and changes only reporter, focused tests and report;
- the real hyphenated reporter module is exercised with SourceFileLoader;
- validation record is bounded, canonical-hashed, outcome/receipt/evidence-bound and excludes summary/log content;
- worker reports 15/15 focused and 119/119 full unittest passes;
- strict reporter correctly did not convert the worker's internal READY label into TASK_COMPLETED.

Acceptance gaps at exact head:
1. Existing terminal marker is trusted from `marker.exists()` without validating its exact schema, receipt_key, state or remote value. An arbitrary pre-existing marker can bypass remote post/comment confirmation and still cause a validation record.
2. `reporter_authority` is set to `codex@wolfram.local`, conflating executor identity with reporter authority; there is no explicit reporter version field/allowlist.
3. Required negative coverage is incomplete: wrong PR branch/base/repository, missing admission, nonzero execution/non-TASK_OUTCOME no-record, and remote-existing receipt replay are not independently tested.
4. PR body remains the initial durability stub and was not updated with final verdict/evidence. The report omits exact final head and retains an obsolete “will be added” sentence.
5. Report says `REPORTER_VALIDATION_RECORD_READY` while the bound task outcome says blocked. The strict receipt is authoritative until the discrepancy and missing cases are resolved.
